sentence: This project studies how RNA nanoparticles reprogram the immune system to fight glioblastoma in mouse and large animal models.
This project studies how neurons control magnesium levels and how a magnesium transporter affects neuronal development in mouse and human neurons.
This project studies how lymphatic vessels work during skin wound healing.
This project tests a way to detect cell-free DNA from tuberculosis bacteria to diagnose tuberculosis in children.
This project builds a tool that uses generative AI to detect and correct stigmatizing language in patient notes about substance use disorders.
This project tries to develop a therapy that works on both the immune system and tumors to treat triple negative breast cancer.
This project studies how the glycocalyx lining blood vessels affects clotting problems in sepsis, using cell culture models.
This project uses single-cell sequencing to find epigenetic changes that drive lung adenocarcinoma to turn into small cell lung cancer.
This project builds a data-driven tool that helps teams decide which patients with cirrhosis are placed on the liver transplant waitlist.
This project studies how innate immune cells drive the onset and progression of genetic mitochondrial disease in a mouse model.
This project studies how a chemokine receptor changes blood vessel growth in chronic myeloid leukemia and helps leukemic stem cells survive treatment.
This project develops clinical study protocols for medical devices that diagnose and treat disorders of the nervous system.
This project studies how azithromycin mass drug administration affects antibiotic resistance in the nasopharynx and gut of children.
This project studies how hepatitis B virus sequences inserted into a gene cause hepatocellular carcinoma.
This project builds a tool that uses optical microcavities to measure the shape of single biomolecules without labels.
This project provides mass spectrometry to measure proteins, lipids and metabolites for cancer researchers.
This project studies how the tip link and transduction channel proteins of the inner ear work in normal and impaired hearing, using computational tools.
This project studies how a family of cytosine deaminases causes mutations and genomic instability in lung cancer.
This project studies how dendritic cells migrate to draining lymph nodes and affect how head and neck cancer responds to immunotherapy.
This project makes viral vectors for pediatric cancer research and helps investigators design and use them.
